detailed_descriptions.en: Burning Sword tells the story of Zhang Yixian (张逸仙) and his pursuit of power and vengeance for the death of his master. Hardcore action combat meets epic boss battles and careful customization, interwoven with subtle environmental storytelling and worldbuilding. Burning Sword emphasizes challenge, progression, and deep combat systems. The story is told subtly, but is full of character, political intrigue, and power dynamics. Starting in the year 1139 during the Southern Song Dynasty (南宋), you play as Zhang Yixian just as he's cast down and nearly killed by the Elder of the Northern Mountain. The martial arts emerged during moments in history like this, when tyranny and brutality must be met with strength and passion. Enter the Burning Sword. Key combat features include: Wuxia-based swordplay and bodily attacks combine into a fierce and flexible combat style that leaves lots of room for experimentation. Players will dodge, parry, strike, combo, and acquire powerful techniques to carve a bloody path through mobs of enemies and make their way back to the Elder to finish the job. The combat rewards skill and timing, and punishes mistakes harshly. Yixian's fury gives birth to a fiery Qi and the ability to wield a burning sword. Qi restores vitality, fuels techniques, and augments combat abilities. It is a scarce but critical resource. Qi Drain A forbidden technique that drains life and Qi from enemies when their Qi vessel is exposed. Rebound Launch nearby objects into enemies to create an opening for your next attack. This martial art also emphasizes agility, speed, lightness and ease of traversal, letting Yixian jump, wall-run, glide, and explore an expansive world. Finally, because the combat is this fun and rewarding, the game also includes an arena that allows for endless replayability, with a high score system that can be pushed as far as your skill allows.
